_what: What the metric contract's `anchor` field actually constrains. PDH, PDL and the seven pivots declare anchor '1d' from contract 54.1.0. Probed live 2026-09-09 on PIVOT_P with get_strategy_column_contract (read-only, compiles a column without reading market values).

results.message: [column-grammar] metric 'pivotP' is anchored to '1d' - it accepts only that absolute timeframe reference, not '4h'

rule: The anchor binds PINNED (absolute) references only: an anchored metric accepts any RELATIVE reference and, among absolute references, only its declared anchor.
_discrepancy: The vendor's battlegrid-strategy-examples skill says of PDH/PDL: 'bind them {abs: "1d"}, which is the only reference the save path accepts on them'. That is STRICTER than what the column contract accepts. The SAVE path was NOT probed - doing so needs a compile, which parks a plan server-side. omega therefore errors on a mismatched absolute reference (measured) and only WARNS on a relative one (vendor claim, unverified).
